overview.description: Asserufen Schafkopf (Ace-calling Schafkopf) is a four-player variant of PfÃ¤lzer Schafkopf. The game announcer calls an ace of a suit to choose a partner; the holder of that ace is the teammate but stays hidden until playing the called ace. In calling games hearts (Herz) is trump. Uses French-suited cards. Caller leads; when the called suit is led, the holder must play the called ace if possible (Unten Raus). Solo options also exist.

history.origins: Pfälzer Schafkopf variant; Asserufen = call the ace (Ass). Hearts trump in calling games; French-suited; Palatinate rules.
history.cultural: Call ace for secret partner; Unten Raus (must play called ace when suit led).

nullReasons.evolution: No documented evolutionary changes; game is a stable Palatinate Schafkopf variant.

setup.players: Four. Caller and called-ace holder are partners (secret until ace is played).
setup.deck: 32 cards French-suited (Schafkopf pack). Hearts trump in calling games.
setup.dealing: Standard Schafkopf deal; caller announces game and calls an ace.

rules.objective: Caller's side aims to make the contract; called ace identifies partner when played.
rules.gameplay: Announcer calls an ace (suit and rank); that suit's ace holder is partner. Hearts are trump in calling games. Follow suit; when the called suit is led, holder must play the called ace if able (Unten Raus). Solo variants: declarer plays alone. Standard Schafkopf trick and point scoring.
keyRules: Call an ace to choose partner; partner stays hidden until playing that ace
Hearts trump in calling games; called ace must be played when suit led if possible

strategy.basic: Call an ace you can support; as partner, play the called ace when it helps the team.
strategy.intermediate: Defend by forcing or trapping the called ace; coordinate with partner once known.
strategy.advanced: Pfälzer Schafkopf strategy: solo bids, tournament Unten Raus, and coordinating with secret partner once revealed.

variations.noVariationsReason: Sources describe only the standard Palatinate Asserufen form; no distinct regional or rule variations are documented.

edgeCases.text: When the called suit is led, the holder of the called ace must play it if able (Unten Raus).
Partner remains hidden until playing the called ace or responding to kontra.
If partner has at least 4 cards of the called suit, may underlead the ace once (Laufsau); thereafter normal play.

engine.deckDescription: One standard 32-card Schafkopf pack: eight ranks (seven through ace) in each of four suits. French or German suit names may be used; no jokers. Used for this Asserufen (calling ace) variant of Schafkopf.
engine.suitDescription: Four suits: in German naming these are acorns, leaves, hearts, and bells; in French they correspond to spades, clubs, hearts, and diamonds. Each suit has eight cards; trump and plain-suit order depend on the bid.
engine.rankDescription: Eight ranks per suit: ace, king, queen (over), jack (under), ten, nine, eight, seven. In trump the order differs (e.g. jack and nine high); the called ace and partners are determined by the Asserufen bid.
engine.dealPattern: Standard Schafkopf deal; eight cards each.
